piece_type: HCP branded website webpages: “T315I Mutation”, “CML OPTIC Trial Efficacy”, “CML PACE Trial Efficacy” (USO-ICL-0558v4.0)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “OS 66% estimated at 5 years (95% CI: 51%, 78%)” | “PFS 50% estimated at 5 years (95% CI: 32%, 65%)” | “ESTIMATED OS AND PFS DATA FOR OPTIC WITH A RESPONSE-BASED DOSING STRATEGY” | “CONSISTENT ESTIMATED OS/PFS THROUGH YEAR 5, EVEN IN PATIENTS WITH A T315I MUTATION” | “Median OS and PFS were not reached”
cases.context: Pie charts and Kaplan-Meier graphs from PACE and OPTIC.
cases.rationale: PACE and OPTIC designed as single-arm trials (per letter); PFS/OS uninterpretable without comparator.
cases.check: Rule: flag PFS/OS/survival/time-to-event claims (incl. cystectomy-free, DSS) when the source trial is single-arm; disclaimers do not count as a fix.

cases.claim: “NCCN CATEGORY 2A PREFERRED RECOMMENDATION” | “Ponatinib is the preferred treatment option for patients with a T315I mutation in any phase.”
cases.context: Cites NCCN CML V.2.2024; current V.3.2025 says “Ponatinib is a treatment option for patients with a T315I mutation in any phase (preferred for AP-CML or BP-CML).”
cases.rationale: Misrepresents current guideline; consistency with the (outdated) cited reference does not mitigate.
cases.check: Rule: guideline claims must match the current guideline version verbatim; flag 'preferred' claims and outdated version citations.
